rules.text: Your Bio-Pet (Bio-Amphibian or Bio-Serpent, chosen at creation): within 120 feet, acting on your turn with its own reaction. Move (no action), Strike (with your Attack action or an attacking jutsu: its Bite or Tongue Lash), Synchronize (Bonus action: a special ability, Dash, Disengage, Hide, Help or a skill action out of combat). At 0 hit points it dies; a long rest ritual brings it back. It levels with you (+1 to two abilities and saves at 4, 8, 12, 16, 19, max +5). Its stat blocks sit in I've Become, Me's option items (Q-E19).
[Bio Branch] Two Biovolutions (more at 7th and 15th): the option items. Saves and attacks use your highest jutsu save DC and attack bonus.

activities.label: Bio-Matter: Doused
activities.text: Once per turn, [Unarmed Damage] in Soft Physique (pick this or the Constitution save). Failure: 1 rank of Doused (2 at 11th).

activities.label: Bio-Matter: Stupor
activities.text: Once per turn, [Unarmed Damage] in Soft Physique. Failure: Stupor (11th: a critical hit inflicts it without a save).

activities.label: Biomass Augment
activities.text: Bonus action, your Bio-Pet within 10 feet, until the end of your turn (7th: up to 1 minute, concentration as a B-Rank jutsu, temporary hit points equal to your level; 15th: two size stages, DR half your level): +1 size, +15 speed, a rank of Mastery to its attacks, Bite and Tongue Lash +1 die (+2 at 11th).

roll.note: Reaction, taking damage: reduce it by this, then move 10 feet without provoking.
A creature you grapple, at the start of each of its turns: your [Unarmed Damage] (twice at 7th, three times at 15th; roll it).

activities.label: Constricting Coil: crush
activities.text: Instead of the damage. Failure: 1 rank of Weakened (2 at 7th, 3 at 15th).

activities.label: DNA Resonance
activities.text: Bonus action, a willing creature in your reach, once per creature per rest (twice at 15th): it also loses 1 rank of a Physical or Sensory condition (7th: and a Mental one).

activities.label: Regenerative Tissue
activities.text: Once per initiative, damage drops you below half your maximum hit points: at the end of that turn.

activities.label: Suppressive Grip
activities.text: A creature you grapple, at the start of each of its turns (your choice). Failure: the damage and 1 rank of Sealed (2 at 11th) while grappled.

rules.text: Regaining hit points from an item, jutsu or feature: your Bio-Pet within 10 feet regains half as much.

activities.label: Shin-Pet focus
activities.text: On initiative until combat ends, or a Bonus action (swap as a Bonus action): your Bio-Pet can be up to 1 mile away (Move only past 120 feet), shares what it sees and hears within 60 feet telepathically, and gains Latch.

activities.label: Shin-Seal focus
activities.text: On initiative until combat ends, or a Bonus action (swap as a Bonus action): mark creatures with Shin-Seals.

roll.note: A hit with your attack, or a Bonus action touching a structure or object; up to your proficiency bonus at once, 1 minute each or until a Hijutsu spends it (marks stay if you swap focus).

rules.text: [Shin Branch] Latch (the Bio-Pet, unseen or Hidden): melee, Dex + Prof to hit; on a hit it's Latched (moves with it; you know where it is; your attacks against it ignore cover and invisibility but full cover, never at disadvantage; it's found by Chakra Sensing or Sight or Perception vs the pet's Stealth DC, then a Bonus action removes it).

10 minutes touching your Bio-Pet: for 24 hours it has +90 speed, telepathy, invisibility while hidden (not to Chakra Sight or Sensing), range 10 miles with shared sight and hearing, and Move and Latch only. Your first initiative within 24 hours in an area it explored is at advantage. 1 minute: it draws a seal and summons you and willing creatures touching you (once per Full Rest). Harmed: it ends and that pet dissolves.

Once per combat, your Bio-Pet's Bite or Tongue Lash damages a non-construct hostile creature: until combat ends gain one of a random resistance it has, a random special sense, or a random save proficiency it has that you lack.

rules.text: [Shin Branch] Two Synthwakenings (more at 7th and 15th): the option items. Saves and attacks use your highest jutsu save DC and attack bonus.

Your Bio-Pet gets jutsu slots (its Constitution modifier + half your level; back on a short or long rest) and the Cast command (Bonus action). It picks 2 D-Rank nature release jutsu you have (no Fuinjutsu, Clone or Kinjutsu; 2 C-Rank at 7th, 2 B-Rank at 15th), using its abilities and your proficiency bonus.

activities.label: Water Augmentation
activities.text: Once per turn, a Water jutsu without an Elemental condition: affected creatures. Failure: Doused (1 rank; on a jutsu with a save, on its failure). 7th: Elemental-condition jutsu add 1 rank; 11th: +1 rank.

activities.label: Lightning Augmentation
activities.text: Once per turn, a Lightning jutsu's Overcharge (or its own failed save): Stupor.

rules.text: Fire: a cube, sphere, cylinder or radius area +5 feet. One effect if the jutsu has several releases.

roll.note: Once per turn, Reaction: an attack on you by a creature you can see has disadvantage. 7th: a miss lets you cast a D-Rank Jinzo Hijutsu at it free in the same reaction (C-Rank at 15th).

rules.text: You can't be Surprised.
A Latched creature is also Shin-Sealed while latched. Latched and Shin-Sealed: its first save against your area Jinzo Hijutsu gets no advantage or jutsu bonuses.

roll.note: Reaction, a creature with your Shin-Seals casts a jutsu you can see: dispel them all; +6 to its cost per seal.

rules.text: A creature can carry up to 5 of your Shin-Seals.

Synchronize can use Multiattack (two of Tongue Lash, Oil Spit or Bite) or Camouflage (Invisible until it attacks, is touched or 1 minute; a rank of Mastery on Latch, Stealth DC +5; 11th: it stays invisible after a Latch).

activities.label: Punishing Seal: Doused
activities.text: A Shin-Sealed creature with Doused, starting its turn concentrating on a Chakra Molding (CM) jutsu. Failure: its upkeep +6 per rank of Doused.

activities.label: Punishing Seal: Stupor
activities.text: A Shin-Sealed creature in Stupor casting a Mobility (M) jutsu. Failure: half speed, and 5 feet of movement per attack this turn.

roll.note: A Shin-Seal within 60 feet: dispel it as part of a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu with a sphere, cube, radius or cylinder: the area centers on the marked creature or object.
